cancel.question: How do I cancel a lesson?
cancel.answer: You can cancel under My bookings. If you cancel at the latest 24 hours before the lesson, it costs nothing and the lesson returns to your balance. A later cancellation is charged in full and the lesson is deducted from the balance.

risk.question: What is the difference between Risk 1 and Risk 2?
risk.answer: Risk 1 is a theory course about alcohol, drugs, fatigue and other risks. Risk 2 is practical training on a skid track about speed and difficult driving conditions. Both are required for a category B licence.

validity.question: How long is my package valid?
validity.answer: Driving lessons and packages are valid for 12 months from purchase. Your balance and the last valid date are shown under My pages. Digital theory has no time limit.

late.answer: The lesson ends at the ordinary end time.

prices.title: Prices and payment
prices.body:
All prices are shown in Swedish kronor including VAT.
You pay by card, Swish or Klarna via Stripe.
The price is taken from the product list at purchase.
Stripe sends the receipt to your email. We do not send our own emails.
Codes and reminders are sent by text message.

delivery.title: How the service is delivered
delivery.body:
You book driving lessons in the calendar on the website. The lesson runs with your instructor at the agreed time.
Digital theory opens when payment is confirmed.
Courses such as Risk 1 and Risk 2 give a seat on a chosen occasion.

validity.title: How long it stays valid
validity.body:
Lesson credits and packages are valid for 12 months from purchase. Unused credits expire.
Digital theory is a one-time purchase. It has no time limit.

cancellation.title: Rescheduling and cancellation
cancellation.body:
You can cancel a driving lesson under My bookings. If you cancel at the latest 24 hours before the lesson, the credit returns to your balance. A later cancellation is charged in full: the lesson is deducted from the balance and a single lesson is not refunded.
If the school cancels, you always get the credit back.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.body:
You have 14 days to withdraw under the distance-selling act.
The period starts when the contract is made.
Exception: if you clearly agree that the service starts during that period, and confirm that you may then lose the withdrawal right, that exception applies to the part already delivered.
Contact us at info@makina.se if you want to withdraw.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.body:
Contact us first at info@makina.se or 070-097 04 83.
If we do not agree, you can turn to the National Board for Consumer Disputes (ARN), arn.se.
You can also use the EU online dispute platform: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr

law.title: Governing law
law.body:
Swedish law applies to the contract.
A dispute is heard by a Swedish general court, unless mandatory consumer rules say otherwise.

collected.title: What we collect
collected.body:
We process name, email and phone number.
We process bookings, payment history and pickup address.
We process theory results and lesson notes written by the instructor.

purpose.title: Purpose and legal basis
purpose.body:
Contract: to book lessons, grant theory access and take payment.
Legal obligation: bookkeeping and receipts.
Legitimate interest: to plan instructor time and improve training.
Consent: optional messages and cookies beyond the necessary ones, if those are added later.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body:
Pickup addresses are deleted 90 days after a completed lesson.
Accounting data is kept under the Bookkeeping Act.
The account and education card are kept while you are a customer, then as long as the law requires.

recipients.title: Recipients and sub-processors
recipients.body:
Stripe handles payments.
Klarna handles payment when you choose Klarna at checkout.
46elks sends SMS.
Google handles sign-in with Google and shows maps and addresses.
Sentry receives error reports.
Railway hosts the service.
Cloudflare R2 stores files and backups.
Some of these may transfer data outside the EU/EEA. Then approved safeguards are used, for example standard contractual clauses.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
You can ask for access, rectification, erasure, data portability and objection.
Signed-in students can export their data and delete the account under My pages.
Deletion anonymises personal data. Some records must be kept for bookkeeping.

supervisory.title: Supervisory authority
supervisory.body: You can complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY), imy.se.
